The Old Spanish Trail is a documentary film about the historic trail tracking the journey of Richard Waller Otis Calef and Jim Clark on horseback 1200 miles from Los Angeles to Santa Fe They rode the trail in two legs fall of 2014 and summer of 2015

programme.desc:
At just 43 years old Emma Victoria Johnson was diagnosed with Stage 4 breast cancer and told she had only 18 months to live Refusing conventional chemotherapy she chose an alternative path that changed everything
In this powerful Patriots With Grit interview Emma shares how she sought treatment at Oasis of Hope Hospital in Mexico the lifestyle changes she made the therapies she underwent and why she believes they saved her life
Whether you agree or disagree this is a remarkable story of courage hope and personal conviction that is inspiring conversations around the world

programme.desc: David Osmond son of Alan Osmond of the legendary Osmond Brothers shares an inspiring story of faith perseverance and hope In 1987 Alan Osmond was diagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis MS a disease that changed the course of his life Nearly 20 years later David received the same diagnosis Faced with uncertainty and tremendous challenges he chose to fight rather than give up In this powerful conversation David shares his personal journey the lessons he learned from watching his father battle MS and the faith that has sustained him through every setback and victory Please Note This interview was filmed several years before Alan Osmonds passing on April 18 2026 We honor his legacy of faith courage and perseverance which continues to inspire people around the world This heartfelt and encouraging conversation is a reminder that no matter what challenges you face hope is real faith matters and giving up is never an option
